Steps that changed far more than usual

Source: R/evolution.R
vp_disruptions.Rd

Disruptions: the steps that changed a graph far more than usual. The change of a step is 1 - jaccard; a step is flagged when its change is more than threshold robust standard deviations above the median of all steps. (The robust standard deviation is the MAD; when more than half of the steps change nothing, the MAD is 0 and the ordinary standard deviation is used instead.)

Usage

vp_disruptions(history, threshold = 3.5)

Arguments

history

A history: the versions of a model, from vp_read_history() or vp_history(), oldest first.

threshold

How many robust standard deviations above the median a change must be to count as a disruption.

Value

The rows of vp_history_changes() with two more columns: score and disruption (TRUE/FALSE).

See also

Other evolution: vp_attachment(), vp_auc(), vp_changed_links(), vp_co_change(), vp_community_history(), vp_compare(), vp_edit_type(), vp_eras(), vp_feature_churn(), vp_feature_states(), vp_flip_flops(), vp_forecast_size(), vp_growth(), vp_history_apply(), vp_history_changes(), vp_history_sizes(), vp_hub_stability(), vp_interaction_changes(), vp_life_cycle(), vp_link_lifetime(), vp_prediction_table(), vp_rename(), vp_rename_candidates(), vp_ripple(), vp_state_moves(), vp_top_movers(), vp_version_distance()

Examples

gens <- c("miband1", "miband2", "miband3", "miband4", "miband6")
history <- vp_history(
  vp_example(paste0(gens, "_realized.uvl")),
  versions = gens,
  or_graph = TRUE
)
vp_disruptions(history)
